note: Small Game, Fish and Parks area on 25-acre Burke Lake, 2 mi east of Burke off US-18: one wooded loop of 15 sites northwest of the lake. Boat ramp, fishing piers, a group picnic shelter and a shoreline trail. Water may be off October through April. --Claude
